person_note: The authorized opening uses sustained third-person narration, while the Goodreads evidence independently includes third-person scene narration centered on Gabriel and other protagonists. A separately quoted interior passage likewise narrates Gabriel externally and renders his thought as 'he thought.' First- and second-person forms in the supplied quotes occur only in dialogue, proverbs, or epigraphs, and no research source indicated alternating narration. The main limitation is that the strongest authorized excerpt covers only Chapter 1, but distributed interior evidence resolves that scope limitation.
